snippet.title: Oiran Survival: Edo Yokai Rush - Story Teaser | A Dark Tale of Revenge
snippet.description:
A story-focused teaser for Oiran Survival: Edo Yokai Rush.

Set in a Japanese dark fantasy world, this survivor-like roguelite action game follows Kocho, an oiran who loses the person she loves to yokai.

Driven by revenge, she continues to fight.
But the stronger she becomes, the more her body and memories begin to break.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3960110/

Oiran Survival: Edo Yokai Rush is a Japanese dark fantasy survivor-like roguelite action game featuring yokai battles, skill growth, equipment progression, Limit Break attacks, and Live2D story scenes.
